name: rapidfish-groundstation
description: Browser-based telemetry visualizer and CSV logger for RapidFish serial data

scripts.build: bun scripts/generate-ui.ts && bun build --compile --minify --outfile dist/RapidFishGroundStation.exe server.ts
scripts.bundle:macos: bun scripts/generate-ui.ts && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/RapidFishGroundStation-mac server.ts
scripts.bundle:win: bun scripts/generate-ui.ts && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/RapidFishGroundStation.exe server.ts
